English.Char_Desc_45: See what is installed and what is out of date
English.Char_Desc_80: Scans everything installed, matches it against winget and shows what is out of date
English.Char_Desc_250: AppGeek scans everything installed on a Windows machine, matches it against the winget catalogue and shows which programs are out of date. Free, with no account and no subscription.
English.Char_Desc_450: AppGeek scans every program installed on a Windows machine, matches each one against the winget catalogue, and shows plainly which are out of date and which are current. Updates are handled by winget itself, so nothing unusual is downloaded. It is free with no Pro tier, no ads and no bundled offers, and it runs without an account.
English.Char_Desc_2000:
AppGeek scans every program installed on a Windows machine and tells you what is out of date.
It matches what is installed against the winget catalogue, so the version data comes from Microsoft's own package repository rather than a list somebody maintains by hand. Updates are performed by winget itself.
No account, no subscription, no ads and no bundled offers in the installer. Windows 10 1809 or later, 64-bit. Free to use, including at work.
